tiles.name: Ersama Low-Lying Coastal Basin & MCS Fortress

default_metrics.visual_evidence: Significant fragmentation in Casuarina/mangrove belt along southern spit; high density of tin-clad informal settlements within 800m of high-tide line.
default_metrics.suggested_preemptive_action: Prioritize rapid mandatory evacuation of Block 4 beach hamlets to Baliapanda Cyclone Shelter.

default_metrics.visual_evidence: Substation switchyard perimeter sits directly adjacent to Taladanda canal embankment with no secondary earthen levee. Silt accumulation in perimeter trench increases flash-inundation risk.
default_metrics.suggested_preemptive_action: Deploy rapid inflatable flood berms along northern switchyard boundary to prevent 33kV busbar submersion.

ERSAMA_SHELTER.name: Ersama Low-Lying Coastal Basin & MCS Fortress

default_metrics.visual_evidence: Engineered two-storey reinforced concrete fortress shelter elevated on +3.8m stilt plinth; tidal feeder creeks present high surge back-flow risk to surrounding unpaved tracks.
default_metrics.suggested_preemptive_action: Stage tractor-drawn amphibious rescue dinghies along the south access ramp before surge reaches +1.5m.
